clm-encoder-axis-unresolved.notes: 30/30 cells from a clean tree at 5e7e3f1. Only the BiomedBERT/BERT contrast is a paired common-document test; the descriptive leader bioelectra-base received no paired test of its own.
clm-encoder-axis-unresolved.text: On the frozen 109-document split the base-encoder axis carries no resolved signal: the preplanned BiomedBERT-versus-BERT paired document bootstrap gives delta -0.0051 with 95% CI [-0.0354, +0.0275] and P(delta > 0) = 0.382.

clm-exact-match-surface-forms.text: Exact matching over the Phase-2 corpus produces 73,096 spans that reduce to 256 raw / 105 case-folded unique surface forms.

clm-freezing-hurts.notes: Corroborated independently in Phase 1 (runs 003 and 004) and on gold data; the effect is far outside the seed band.
clm-freezing-hurts.text: Freezing lower encoder layers reduces F1 on this task; unfreezing all layers moved gold-003 to gold-004 by +0.072 F1 and +0.108 precision.

clm-gold008-seed-band.notes: Supersedes the earlier +-0.007 band measured at lr 3e-5.
clm-gold008-seed-band.text: The gold-008 recipe has a three-seed mean of 0.8143 +/- 0.0175 test F1, so its recorded single-seed 0.8197 is not a distinguishable result.

location.anchor: Data leakage from the split strategy

clm-pmid-split-leakage.notes: Two write-ups of the same incident inside one repository; they share an independence key, so this is not two-source corroboration.
clm-pmid-split-leakage.text: Splitting the Phase-2 dataset by pathway instead of by PMID leaked text between splits and inflated validation F1 to 0.980.

evidence.locator: Headline - did we break the near-lookup problem?

clm-silver-variation-share.notes: Counts predate the direction-bug fix, which moved exact 999->1012 and variation 251->238.
clm-silver-variation-share.text: In the 1k silver pilot, variation and synonym spans together are 425 of 1,996 spans (21%) - mentions exact matching would miss.

clm-student-vs-teacher-recall.notes: Overlap-based scoring on 10 abstracts; the teacher leads on span-exact scoring against the guide-based gold, which is a different question.
clm-student-vs-teacher-recall.text: On the 10-abstract golden set with overlap scoring, gold-008 recalls 69/70 gold targets against the qwen2.5:14b teacher's 58/70.

clm-teacher-span-exact-lead.notes: Kept contested on purpose: the two sources measure different questions (boundary-exact vs mention-found) and neither replaces the other.
clm-teacher-span-exact-lead.text: Measured span-exact against the guide-based gold, the qwen2.5:14b teacher scores F1 0.864 while the best student sits near 0.82.

evidence.locator: Training is not reproducible at a fixed seed

location.anchor: Training is not reproducible at a fixed seed

clm-training-nondeterminism.notes: Two replicates cannot separate an unlucky draw from a systematic shift; the cause of the level difference is unresolved. The replicate table is absent from the current master revision; the evidence remains the superseded 2026-08-01 capture.
clm-training-nondeterminism.text: Training does not reproduce a recorded result at a fixed seed: the biomedbert-base lr 5e-05 seed 42 cell recorded 0.8199 and two replicates gave 0.7662 and 0.7736.
